portal.intro: Who uses the resident app, who has not signed in for a month, who was invited and who is still to be invited. Last sign-in is shown as a date and a kind of device only, and residents never see any of this about each other. Invitations are simulated: nothing is sent.
portal.adoptionBody: {{flats}} of {{occupied}} occupied flats have someone who signed in during the last 30 days.

kpi.neverHint: {{expired}} invitations ran out · {{notInvited}} not invited yet

portal.selectAll: Select all who can be invited ({{count}})
portal.emptyBody: Try another filter, block or search.
portal.unverifiedHint: Their link to the flat is not verified, so they cannot be invited yet. Verify it on the flat first.
portal.revokeEffect: They are signed out of the resident app on every device at once, and cannot sign in again until they are invited again. Their bills, payments and receipts are not affected.
portal.revoked: App access for {{name}} closed. Their devices are signed out.
portal.revokeFailed: Access could not be closed. Try again.
portal.vacantBody: Nobody lives here, so there is nobody to invite. Each opens its flat.

flatTab.title: Resident app access

flatTab.vacant: This flat is vacant: nobody to invite.

flatTab.all: Open resident app access for the whole society

invite.subtitle: To the resident app (simulated: nothing is sent)

channelHint.whatsapp: A WhatsApp message with a personal link. Only for people who agreed to WhatsApp messages.
channelHint.sms: A text message with a personal link. Only for people who agreed to text messages.
channelHint.email: An email with a personal link. Only for people who agreed to emails.
channelHint.printed_code: A printed letter to hand over or put under the door: no consent needed, nothing is sent electronically.

skip.not_verified: their link to the flat is not verified
skip.resend_limit: already sent three times this week

invite.message: Assalam-o-alaikum {{name}}, Al-Noor Residency invites you to its resident app for flat {{flat}}: see your bills, pay by bank transfer and keep your receipts. Open your personal link within {{days}} days. A one-time code confirms it is you.
invite.letter: Dear {{name}}, Al-Noor Residency invites you to its resident app for flat {{flat}}. Open the address on this letter within {{days}} days; a one-time code to your phone confirms it is you.
invite.letterSteps: Open this address on your phone, confirm the code we send to your number, then choose your language and text size.
invite.rules: Invitations are bound to this society, the flat and the verified person, and run out after 14 days. A person can be sent at most three times a week.
invite.simulated: Nothing was sent: this is a demo. Each invitation below shows the personal link a real message would carry.

errors.tooMany: Invite at most 50 people at a time.
errors.notOpen: This invitation is no longer open.

invite.closed: This invitation is no longer open. Ask your society office for a new one.
invite.linkEnded: Your link to this flat has ended, so this invitation cannot be used. Ask your society office.

code.expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
code.locked: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new code.
code.wrongField_one: That code is not right. {{count}} try left.
code.wrongField_other: That code is not right. {{count}} tries left.
code.label: 6-digit code
code.hint: Digits only. The code works for 10 minutes.
code.demoBody: A real system would send this code to {{to}}. Here it is shown on screen.

errors.current: This is the device you are using. Use “Sign out” instead.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.intro: Every device and app where you are signed in. Sign out of any you do not recognise.
sessions.revokeEffect: Whoever uses that device will have to sign in again. Nothing else changes.
sessions.signOutOthersEffect: Every device except this one is signed out. You stay signed in here.
sessions.noOthers: You are signed in only on this device.
sessions.failed: That did not work. Try again.

errors.phoneForMessages: Add a mobile number to receive text or WhatsApp messages.

profile.introStaff: Your details, the devices you are signed in on, and recent security activity.
profile.introResident: Your contact details, the devices you use, and your data.
profile.name: Name

contact.title: Contact and messages
contact.intro: Used to reach you about your account and your flat. Messages go only on the channels you agree to.

consents.title: Service messages
consents.hint: Notices, reminders and invitations. Never advertising.

errors.notHousehold: Only someone who owns or lives in the flat can add a household member.
errors.notPending: This request has already been decided.

household.intro: The people registered at your flats. Only the society office can add someone: ask here and the office checks first.
household.name: Full name
household.phoneHint: Optional. Only the office sees it.
household.sent: Sent: the office will check and add {{name}}.
household.privacyNote: Other residents never see who lives in your flat. The office sees names and roles only to run the building.

office.intro: Who lives in each flat, and residents’ requests to add household members. Approving adds the person as verified.
office.failed: That did not work. Try again.

errors.purpose: Say what the export is for (at least 10 characters).
errors.nothing: Nothing you chose is yours to export.
errors.notWaiting: This export is not waiting for a decision.
errors.cannotWiden: An approval can only remove data from an export, never add it.
errors.expired: This export has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.notReady: This export is not ready to download.

export.newSubtitle: Only what you can already open is included. Personal or financial data needs an approver.
export.purposeHint: At least 10 characters. The approver sees this.
export.needsApproval: Contains personal or financial data, so someone with approval rights must approve it before you can download it.
export.noApproval: No personal or financial data: ready to download straight away.
export.emptyBody: Ask for a copy of records you can open, for a meeting or an audit.
export.cancelEffect: The request is withdrawn. Nothing is exported.
export.yours: Your request: someone else with approval rights decides.
export.decideSubtitle: Requested by {{name}}. Approve all of it, remove datasets, or decline. Nothing can be added.
export.failed: That did not work. Try again.

errors.details: Tell us a little more (at least 10 characters).
errors.open: You already have an open request of this kind.

completeEffect.access: Confirm that the copy was given to the resident.
completeEffect.correction: Confirm that the record was corrected.
completeEffect.deletion: The resident’s account and contact details are removed. Bills and payments are kept, without the name, as the law requires.

privacy.noteLabel: What was done (the resident sees this)

retention.contacts_removed_financial_kept: Contact details and the resident app account were removed. Bills and payments are kept without the name, as the law requires.

errors.whiteLabel: A custom brand colour needs the White-label add-on.

accept.title: Welcome, {{name}}
accept.intro: Your society office invited you to its resident app.
accept.notYou: Not {{name}}, or not your flat? Do not continue. Ask your society office to correct it.

benefits.bills: See your bills and pay by bank transfer
benefits.household: See who is registered in your household
benefits.privacy: Only you and the society office see your details

accept.languageHint: You can change it at any time.
accept.confirmBody: We send a 6-digit code to {{to}}. It proves the invitation reached the right person.
accept.confirmBodyNoPhone: We send a 6-digit code to the contact your society office has for you.
accept.signedInAs: This device is signed in as {{name}}. Joining signs that account out here.
accept.joinedAnnounce: You have joined {{organisation}}. Next, set up the app.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitations last 14 days. Ask your society office to send a new one.

accepted.title: This invitation was already used

revoked.title: This invitation is no longer valid
revoked.body: The society office cancelled it, or your link to the flat changed. Ask the office if you think this is a mistake.

not_found.title: We could not find this invitation
not_found.body: Check the link in your message, or ask your society office for a new one.

accept.signIn: Sign in with my mobile number

signIn.title: Sign in to the resident app
signIn.intro: Use the mobile number your society office has for you. We send you a one-time code.
signIn.noCode: If this number has resident app access, a code is on its way. No code? Ask your society office for an invitation.
signIn.noCodeDemo: Demo: this number has no active resident app account, so nothing was sent. A real system shows the same message either way, so nobody can find out who lives here.
signIn.demoNumbersBody: Fictional residents whose accounts are active. Anyone who joins by invitation can sign in with their own number too.

notice.session_ended: You were signed out because this device was signed out from another device.
notice.portal_access_revoked: Your resident app access was closed by the society office. Ask the office if you think this is a mistake.
notice.switched_app: You switched to the other app on this device.

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: The app and its messages use this language. You can change it later in Settings.

theme.title: Light or dark?
theme.body: Choose what is easiest on your eyes. “Follow my device” changes when your phone does.

done.title: You are all set, {{name}}
done.bills: See what you owe and pay it
done.profile: Check your contact details and devices
done.settings: Text size, language and colours stay in Settings.

activity.intro: Sign-ins, sign-outs and changes to your account, newest first.

kind.session_revoked_by_admin: A device was signed out by an administrator

activity.unfamiliarStaff: Something you do not recognise? Sign out that device and tell your administrator.
activity.unfamiliarResident: Something you do not recognise? Sign out that device and tell the society office.

switch.failed: The switch did not work. Try again.

myData.intro: Download a copy of your own records, or ask the office to correct or delete them.
myData.holdsTitle: What the society holds about you
myData.downloadHint: A JSON file with your details, flats, bills, payments and devices. Nothing about other people.
myData.requestsIntro: The society office answers within 30 days.

kind.access: A full copy from the office

kindHint.access: The office prepares everything it holds about you.
kindHint.correction: Say what is wrong and what it should say.
kindHint.deletion: Your account and contact details are removed. Bills and payments are kept as the law requires, without your name.

data.intro: Ask for a copy of records you can already open, decide on exports waiting for approval, and answer residents’ privacy requests. Files are simulated.

users.intro: Your organisation’s staff, where they are signed in to the office app, and their recent security activity. Residents’ access is managed in Resident app access.
users.signOutEffect: {{name}} will have to sign in again on that device. It is recorded in their security activity.
users.signOutAllEffect: Every office app session of {{name}} ends. It is recorded in their security activity.
users.noManage: You can see sessions but not end them: that needs session management.
users.yoursHint: This is you. Sign out your own devices in Profile and devices.
users.residentNote: Resident app sessions are never shown here.

branding.intro: The colours of the office app and the resident app for everyone in {{org}}. The page shows your choice straight away; nothing changes for others until you save.
branding.unchanged: These colours are already in use.
branding.neverChanged: Not chosen yet: Evergreen, the PropertyOS default, is used.
branding.overrideNote: Anyone who chose their own palette, or high contrast, keeps it: personal accessibility settings always come first.
branding.yourOverride: You chose your own palette or high contrast, so this page cannot preview the organisation’s colours for you. Others see them.
branding.brandIntro: A custom colour must stay readable on every surface in light and dark mode. The platform checks it and works out the hover, soft and dark-mode shades.
branding.brandLocked: Saving a custom colour needs the White-label add-on. You can still check a colour and preview it here.
branding.pass: Readable everywhere. The other shades were worked out for you.
branding.fail: Not readable enough in some places:
branding.suggestion: The nearest darker shade that passes is {{colour}}.

properties.intro: Your flats in {{org}}, what you owe on each, and who is registered there.

properties.notFound: This flat is not one of yours.
